summary: An excellent preliminary report. Your Great Barrier Reef monitoring mission is clearly justified with quantified objectives, explicit users, and good referencing. Your Gantt plan is robust, with contingency triggers and a clear rationale tied to mission logic. Your verified orbit calculations and STK start show strong progress, and presentation is polished. To reach the very top, strengthen trade justification (why a new mission over existing satellites) and quantify downlink/data-volume needs.
next_steps: Justify the sun-synchronous orbit choice against local time of node, since consistent illumination matters for coral colour-change detection.
Quantify the data volume and downlink rate needed to meet your 24-hour delivery objective for 10 m GSD weekly imaging of the 2300 km reef.
Add a brief comparison with existing missions (e.g. Sentinel-2) to explain why a new satellite is needed, and complete reference details (titles/author info) where missing.

criteria.C1: Accomplished (9/10). Your mission goal, four quantified objectives, users (AIMS as operator, GBRMPA as customer) and their needs are clearly stated and traced back to user requirements, with good literature support ([1]-[6]). To fully secure the top level, briefly argue why a new satellite is needed compared with existing missions such as Sentinel-2.
criteria.C2: Accomplished (9/10). Your Gantt chart (Figure 1) with task descriptions, float, and the risk/contingency table (Table 1) with triggers and responses is robust, and you clearly explain why tasks are ordered by mission logic (imaging requirements fix orbit before ground control). Information sources are tabulated (Table 2). Adding a weekly hour budget would complete the plan.
criteria.C3: Accomplished (9/10). Your hand calculations are verified: a=6978 km gives T=5801 s, 14.9 orbits/day, sun-sync inclination 97.8° at 600 km, and a 24.2° ground-track shift using the sidereal day. You interpret the swath-vs-revisit trade, tie results to contingencies, and have started an STK scenario that agrees with your hand calculation. Clearly on track for completion.
criteria.C4: Accomplished (9/10). Your report has a logical structure with clear headings, labelled figures and tables with captions (e.g. Figure 1, Table 3), consistent formatting, professional tone, and in-text citations ([1]-[11]) matching the reference list. Writing is clear and concise. Minor improvement: complete full titles and author details for some references.
